answers: 불고기 3인분 주세요. (3 is read as 삼: 삼인분)
저기요, 저희 비빔밥 두 개 주문했어요.
떡볶이 덜 맵게 해 주세요. 그리고 앞접시 두 개 주세요.
물티슈 좀 주세요. 그리고 반찬 좀 더 주세요.
저희 따로 계산할게요. 그리고 영수증도 주세요. (각자 계산할게요 is also correct, but 각자 is not in the list.)
exercises: Fill in the blank with a word from the list. You just sat down and want to see what food they have: ___ 좀 주세요.
Fill in the blank. There are three of you, and you want bulgogi for three people: 불고기 ___ 주세요.
Fill in the blank with the past form of 주문하다. You ordered 10 minutes ago, but your food has not come yet: 저기요, 저희 비빔밥 두 개 ___.
Fill in the two blanks with words from the list. You want your tteokbokki less spicy, and you want two small plates to share it: 떡볶이 ___ 해 주세요. 그리고 ___ 두 개 주세요.
Fill in the three blanks with words from the list. Your hands are sticky, and all the side dishes are gone: ___ 좀 주세요. 그리고 ___ 좀 ___ 주세요.
Fill in the two blanks with words from the list. You are at the counter with a friend. You each pay for your own food, and you want a receipt: 저희 ___ 계산할게요. 그리고 ___도 주세요.
objective: Learners can use 10 key restaurant words (메뉴판, 인분, 주문하다, 반찬, 앞접시, 물티슈, 덜 맵게, 더 주세요, 따로 계산하다, 영수증) to make short, polite requests to restaurant staff, from ordering to paying.
summary: Ten words you need in a Korean restaurant, from sitting down to paying. You learn to ask for the menu, order by the number of servings, ask for small plates, wet wipes, more side dishes or less spice, pay separately, and get a receipt. Each word has one real example sentence. The exercises ask you to use the words in new situations.
title: 식당에서 주문하고 부탁하기: 핵심 어휘 10

words.meaning: menu (the physical menu you hold or see on the wall)
serving(s) for one person, used after a number (2인분 = food for two)
words.exampleMeaning: Two servings of pork belly, please.
Excuse me, we're ready to order.

words.meaning: small side dishes served with a Korean meal
words.exampleMeaning: What is this side dish called?

words.meaning: small plate for putting your share of food from a shared dish
words.exampleMeaning: Could we have some small plates?

words.meaning: wet wipe (for cleaning your hands at the table)
less spicy (a request about how the food is cooked)
words.exampleMeaning: Can you make it less spicy?

words.meaning: more, please (asking for a refill or an extra portion)
words.exampleMeaning: One more bowl of rice, please.

words.meaning: to pay separately (each person pays for their own food)

words.exampleMeaning: I don't need a receipt, thanks.
